summary: Lion Group Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing that its wholly owned subsidiary Lion Wealth Management holds an exclusivity agreement, signed 10 April 2026, with Skyfame Realty (Holdings) Limited (In Liquidation, HKEX: 00059) and its joint provisional liquidators regarding a proposed restructuring to resume Skyfame trading. Skyfame submitted a resumption proposal on 17 September 2026 and sought extension of the remedial period to 31 December 2026; the Hong Kong High Court on 18 September granted leave to convene a scheme creditors meeting expected late October or early November 2026, with a sanction hearing tentatively 20 November 2026. No price, stake, or board recommendation is stated; watch scheme creditor approval and HKEX resumption conditions.
